## At heart

**Word Power 55 · English idioms**

### Meaning

Basically; as one really is by nature.

### Usage

1. Atal Bihari Vajpayee was the Prime Minister of India, but he was a poet at heart.
2. A father is usually said to be very strict, but he is very kind at heart.

### Your turn

Use “at heart” in a sentence of your own. The original lesson image also includes Hindi support and illustrations.
